summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc and a systemd service inventory-worker running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user on node1; verified via ps that the running process is owned by inventorysvc. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and service health, issued systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-started on boot, enabled, active, and still running under inventorysvc.
